text.description_html:
LCN 4040XP-632 Polished Brass Door Closer "Super Smoothee"

The LCN 4041XP heavy duty, double-lever arm door closer designed for institutional and other high traffic applications.

The wide choice of options, installation accessories and ease of installation offer maximum versatility. The LCN P4041 is UL - and ULC-listed for self-closing doors without hold-open.

Tested and certified under ANSI Standard A156.4 Grade One. The LCN SUPER SMOOTHEE is LCN's most flexible heavy duty closer, non-sized cylinder for interior doors up to 5' and exterior doors up to 4'. Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting.

Features and Specifications of The LCN 4040XP-US3 Polished Brass Door Closer

  • Adjustable closing speed
  • Adjustable latching speed
  • Adjustable back check
  • Maximum Door Size: 60" Interior / 48" Exterior
  • Maximum Door Weight: 258 lbs
  • Spring Tension: Adjustable 3-6
  • Tri packed for regular, top jamb or parallel arm mounting
  • Handed
  • Grade 1 for Ten Million Cycles
  • Cast Iron Housing
  • Forged Steel Arm
  • Double Heat Treated Steel Pinion
  • All Weather Fluid
  • LCN Fast " Power Adjust "
  • UL & cUL Listed
  • Polished Brass Finish
  • 30 Year Warranty
  • LCN 4041 Information (PDF)

NOTE: the standard arm shown in the upper right product image is included.

*Important When selecting Door Hand for this door closer:
1. Stand on the Push Side of the door, facing the door.
2. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Left", choose "Left Hand Door".
3. If the "Pivot Hinge" is on your "Right", choose "Right Hand Door".
